summary: Stop the Controller foundation push and pull request runs of one commit cancelling each other (BUG-0412): phase1.yml runs on push to main only and on pull requests. API impact: none.

guide.reason: CI trigger configuration only; no operator-visible behaviour, installer, CLI or configuration changes.

api.reason: No Controller, Core or client-facing contract is involved; only when a CI workflow starts.

roadmap.reason: No phase scope or acceptance gate changes. Every commit bound for main is still checked by its pull request run or by the main push run.

state.reason: Workflow trigger configuration holds no product state.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_security: 10 tests OK. Negative control: restoring the '**' push trigger in one workflow copy makes test_phase1_runs_once_per_pull_request_commit fail with a Lists differ assertion; restoring the fix passes. The cancellation rule was read from the forge's Actions concurrency source (earlier waiting or blocked runs in a group are cancelled by a newer run, running ones too when cancel-in-progress is true) and matches the observed runs: push run 4263 cancelled while pull request run 4267 of the same commit passed. NOT EXECUTED: a hosted pull request run with the new trigger; it needs a push. Not changed and still open: on main pushes Controller foundation and Release share the group and one cancels the other (runs 4255 and 4256).
